location_description: Pompano Beach ( POMP-ə-noh) is a city in Broward County, Florida, along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean, just north of Fort Lauderdale. The nearby Hillsboro Inlet forms part of the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway. As of the 2020 census, the city's population was 112,046.
